changeSet.id: set dateAccessed to createdDate when dateAccessed is NULL
changeSet.author: vkumra
changeSet.sql: UPDATE CLUSTER SET dateAccessed = createdDate WHERE dateAccessed IS NULL

changeSet.author: vkumra
changeSet.comment: Mysql 5.7+ cannot add a not null constraint with a default value simultaneously. This changeSet has been modified to reflect that; the validCheckSum is the checksum from when the table was not altered, but with addNotNullConstraint and addDefaultValue.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE CLUSTER MODIFY COLUMN dateAccessed TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01 00:00:01.000000'
